notes.title: Gallery Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Gallery features update, new backgrounds for puzzles and much more![/b][/h1]

[b]▪ This is a big update right away for TitTok Girls and Titfuck Girls Easy.

▪ Improved Gallery:
• Now it's easier to take screenshots in the Gallery,
• If you do not move the mouse for 3 seconds, then all the controls will disappear,
• You can scroll through the pictures in the Gallery with both the mouse and the arrows on the keyboard,
• The Gallery also fully supports all Gamepads.

▪ In TitTok Girls Easy, the control of gamepads has been redesigned as much as possible.

▪ Improved positioning of some Girls inside the puzzles.

▪ Some backgrounds in puzzles have been replaced, the backgrounds have become more beautiful.

▪ Also replaced some of the backgrounds in the Gallery.

▪ The version of the engine has been upgraded to the latest and corresponding to modern standards.

▪ Improved stability and performance.

▪ A lot of corrections, based on the requests of the players.[/b]

[h3][b]▪ Many other minor changes and fixes:[/b][/h3]
[b]In order not to overload the news, I will not describe minor technical and imperceptible changes to the eye. But a lot of work has been done these days. Many thanks to all those who report bugs and problems! Thank you, dear players, thanks to you the game is getting better![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805270/TitTok_Girls/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822830/TitTok_Girls_Easy/

[h1][b]A live support chat with the developer is also available: [url=https://s.team/chat/Y5SG9zpR]TitTok Live Support[/url][/b][/h1]

notes.title: Cumulative Update

tags.feature: ▪ Japanese language support has been added (a lot of work has been done!)
▪ Tips for Japanese have been added;
▪ Localization of new design elements in all languages;
▪ The addendum has been finally transferred to the new design;
▪ The ending is now completely done in a new, green design;
▪ The name of the supplement is now visible in the final credits, so you can brag to your friends on screenshots;
▪ The Secret Achievement in the credits works correctly;
▪ The Easterling in level 7 has now been added to the add-on! Now there's no need to turn off the DLC to get the achiever for the passchalk. Everything is now easy! Like the add-on, easy =)
▪ Pussycat mode support has been improved (no erotica mode). Now there are pussies everywhere in this mode!
▪ Japanese language support has been added (great work done!);

▪ Completely redesigned leaderboard display mode. Millisecond values are now correctly and beautifully displayed in thousandths (01:04:666) of seconds! In words it is easy and simple, but a lot of work has been done on it.
